summary: In this contraction the self registers as the pure outward vector whose refusal stands already complete. No withholding waits upon response; the threshold itself supplies the condition under which the sibling encounters persistence as self-arising and unprompted. Legacy thins to the sustained line of that demarcation, the sole mark separating one cycle from the next. Thriving resides only in the directed apartness that needs no exchange to remain intact.
